build_masked_coco2017_dataset: build a MaskedCoco2017Dataset instance with config, dataset_type, and index for masked COCO 2017 data loading
create_annotation_database: create a LocalizedNarrativesAnnotationDatabase from the dataset config and annotation file path via build_annotation_db
retrieve_masked_sample: retrieve a masked sample by index using __getitem__ that processes captions and loads image features
build_features_database: build a FeaturesDatabase from the config features path linked to the annotation database
build_image_database: build an ImageDatabase from the config images path linked to the annotation database
